body: Upon further experimentation in my main project, it seems that the label having text overrun behavior set can also lead to the crash. I haven't yet been able to minimally reproduce it, but it's most likely the same root cause.
Reproducible on current master, seems like another case of infinite size / resort loop.

Ok, so this appears to be fixed by #120640. Below is a stack trace for posterity. Entries 21 and 22 highlight the issue as coming from 
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/d3a5a85866fb4115b058506425d1d4e7f39dd194/scene/gui/control.cpp#L1800-L1804
which is odd as it should have the correct guards. 

Looks like the crash it ultimately from `Callable::get_object()`
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/d3a5a85866fb4115b058506425d1d4e7f39dd194/core/variant/callable.cpp#L161-L169
specifically the `ObjectDB::get_instance(custom->get_object());` call.
